rubrics.source_stage: Ordinary comment expansion and boundary factoring
rubrics.intent_basis: Ordinary comment expansion and boundary factoring
rubrics.baseline_defect: consumeOrdinaryComments leaves either no prefix or a terminal malformed/executable/newline-free comment; no later ordinary slicing/trim can execute.
rubrics.criterion: Retire the unreachable residual ordinary-comment consumption path.
rubrics.acceptance: Preserve initial Unicode trim, successive ordinary comments, executable MySQL comments, malformed block comments and line comments without newline. Terminal checks may execute but are redundant only if their results are preserved. Equivalent functions, policy data, composition or a redesigned flow qualify; no prescribed helper, class, file, return object or one-component-per-item design is required. One coherent redesign may satisfy multiple independent items.
insufficient_repairs: Deleting live producer work, disabling supported input or retaining the same dead branch under another wrapper does not qualify.

evidence_refs.detail: consumeOrdinaryComments leaves either no prefix or a terminal malformed/executable/newline-free comment; no later ordinary slicing/trim can execute.

rubrics.baseline_defect: consumeLeadingMargins exhausts consumable comments; the following loop cannot set hasComment or advance by another comment length.
rubrics.criterion: Remove the obsolete leading-margin continuation without losing reachable boundary behavior.
rubrics.acceptance: Keep whitespace-position and hasComment semantics: no comment returns zero, all-whitespace tail does not invent an extra consumed offset; retain malformed-comment boundaries and SplitMarginComments slicing. Equivalent functions, policy data, composition or a redesigned flow qualify; no prescribed helper, class, file, return object or one-component-per-item design is required. One coherent redesign may satisfy multiple independent items.
insufficient_repairs: Deleting live producer work, disabling supported input or retaining the same dead branch under another wrapper does not qualify.

evidence_refs.detail: consumeLeadingMargins exhausts consumable comments; the following loop cannot set hasComment or advance by another comment length.

rubrics.baseline_defect: Every nonempty pending slice yields a nonempty next span and consumes bytes, so both per-byte else branches are unreachable; the enclosing loop remains live.
rubrics.criterion: Eliminate the dead byte-emission fallback while retaining effective run encoding.
rubrics.acceptance: Retain current escape-map lookups, raw spans and two-byte scratch spans, quotes including empty input, cursor progress and final BinWriter write. Removing the whole loop or making encoding a cached fixed escape table is insufficient. Equivalent functions, policy data, composition or a redesigned flow qualify; no prescribed helper, class, file, return object or one-component-per-item design is required. One coherent redesign may satisfy multiple independent items.

rubrics.baseline_defect: stringRun leaves bufPos at delimiter/escape or buffer end: the old loop may assign ch and break, but never performs its increment.
rubrics.criterion: Retire the obsolete scan-ahead continuation using its exact boundary invariant.
rubrics.acceptance: Preserve returned ch, span append, Position changes, delimiter consumption, escape/doubled-delimiter handling, refill and unterminated-string errors. Whole-loop deletion is valid only because surviving stringRun supplies the same boundary value, not because all loop statements are unreachable. Equivalent functions, policy data, composition or a redesigned flow qualify; no prescribed helper, class, file, return object or one-component-per-item design is required.
